# Learned instinct: secrets-no-hardcoded-credentials (confidence 1)

Hardcoded credentials (passwords, API tokens, keys, connection strings) in any source-controlled file are a CRITICAL violation. The pan-egress-filter and secrets-scanner will block and reject any diff containing these. Use Vault lookups at runtime or protected/masked CI variables as a fallback. Gitleaks and Secret Detection run in CI and pre-commit as the detection layer.

Source: PCI DSS v4.0.1 Req 8.3.1; OWASP Secrets Management
